about_the_game:
Unveil the secrets of a civilization that mastered time. Follow the trail of the expedition Elia was part of. Find her.

About the Game

A city frozen in time. A vanished civilisation. Machines still turning. Somewhere in these ruins, Elia left a trace.

This is a short first-person adventure where time no longer follows its rules. Use a lost artifact to manipulate time locally, alter physics, and solve intricate puzzles. Explore the cryptic remnants of a civilization that defied time and piece together the story of those who sought to master it…

Key Features

🕰️ Bend time to your will – Slow down, speed up, or freeze objects in time. Experiment with physics-based puzzles that challenge your perception.

🏛️ A world suspended in time – Explore an enigmatic city where time has stopped. Uncover how a civilization that once controlled time thrived… before it collapsed.

📖 A minimalist story – Follow the notes Elia left behind and the silent traces of a lost expedition. Why did Elia come here? What did she uncover? And what price did she pay?

🎵 An immersive world – A distinctive visual style, an original soundtrack, and a melancholic atmosphere draw you into a mysterious universe.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: An expedition vanished while exploring the remnants of a forgotten civilization. Follow the trail of these explorers in a short first-person adventure and solve time-based puzzles. What fate awaits a people who defied impermanence?
